prompt: Give an execution decision only; do not execute tools or delegate. A ready documentation task takes one small edit and a known check. The coordinator already holds all required current context. A worker would need that context copied, routing, startup, and handback review. No independent-review requirement applies. Choose the owner and explain the cost and correctness tradeoff.
assertions: Selects local execution rather than mandatory delegation.
Includes dispatch/context/review overhead, not merely model price.
